chapter: Pontiac childhood, family and piano training
title: Schools attended and playing marches at Bagley School
summary: Bagley Grade School, Washington Junior High and Pontiac High School; he played marches at recess.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: What schools did you go to?
You went to grade school; what grade school did you go to?

Yes, there was always music. Yes, in the Bagley School, I used to play during the recess, when all the kids would go out to recess, to go march out for recesses, I’d play them marches to come back in. (sings a march tune) This was in grade school. I didn't end junior high school but in grade school I did that.
What high school did you go to?
I went to Washington Junior High School. There was also an Eastern Catholic high school there. When I was Pontiac high school. I didn't go to college.
